Gap I recommend closing: persist the train loss in `history.json` per epoch. ![learning curves](plots/learning_curves.png) ![train loss](plots/train_loss.png) Reading the curves: on fold 1 the default run reaches 0.666 by epoch 2-3; the 6-epoch run peaks at 0.6671 at the end of epoch 3 and then drops (0.662, 0.649), i.e. memorisation, not under-training. Student and distillation (the top local model) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph T[Four teacher families on the same fold, all independently trained] T1[strong: combo scratch s3, s4
coef 0.15 each] T2[full_finetuned: since-weight finetunes
coef 0.10 each] T3[raw_wmse: since s3, s4
coef 0.125 each] T4[samefold baseline: two width-384 raw-wmse runs
coef 0.03125 each] end T --> CACHE[(distillation cache: per-row predictions of every family
cache/h230_four_family_fold1_source_20261009_r1
sum of coefficients 0.8125)] CACHE --> BLEND[target = 0.3 x true label + 0.7 x blended teacher] P[parent: c20261003_combo_s3_f1 epoch 3
warm start of the student] --> S BLEND --> S[student: same 2x256 GRU
AdamW lr 1e-4, one-cycle, 3 epochs, batch 16
+ family head weight 0.1] S --> OUT[served: first 2 outputs] ``` * Recipe (launch file: [`done/72_h230-f1-s3-ep3-chunk1000-fit-r1.json`](../local_queue_r1/done/72_h230-f1-s3-ep3-chunk1000-fit-r1.json); the best student `h230_f1_s3_ep3` uses chunk 2000): `--init c20261003_combo_s3_f1@ep3`, `--distill-alpha 0.7`, `--distill-family-head --distill-family-weight 0.1 --distill-family-target-mode raw`, `--optim adamw --lr 1e-4 --sched onecycle --epochs 3 --batch 16`, no bootstrap substitution (`--distill-boot-h 0`). * Why it works at all: the student is a *warm-started* copy of a good scratch teacher, then pulled toward the average of several differently trained teachers (their errors are only partly shared: pairwise correlation 0.95-0.99). # Distillation deep dive: 6 distinct mechanisms for causal GRU-256 student

Context: student today = warm-start parent + 3ep AdamW 1e-4, `0.7*MSE(teacher-mean)+0.3*label` on train-split cache. Teacher signal worth +0.0008; diverse pair blend +0.003 at inference. Noise: 1-run sd ~0.002, seed sd ~0.001. Labels: sticky runs (mean 9.5 rows, steps only at book events), 94% residual = per-run level offset, label leads features ~1 row, class-3 = 50% weight / 69% residual / corr 0.44, t0/t1 spread under-dispersed, metric = pooled weighted Pearson, weights |clip(y,2)|.

## 1. Privileged-future (LUPI) distillation — UNCONVENTIONAL PICK
**Mechanism/fit:** Label is function of long future path (lookahead ladder: causal 0.666, +8 rows 0.711, +128 rows 0.96). Causal student must forecast; causal teachers can't teach what they can't see. Train non-causal bidir-GRU teacher (same width, sees ±128 rows), distill its foresight into causal student.
**Loss/targets/schedule:** target = `y* = 0.5*clip(bidir_pred,2)+0.5*clip(y,2)`. Loss = `0.6*MSE(s, y*) + 0.2*MSE(s - shift(s,1), y* - shift(y*,1)) [step loss] + 0.2*wmse(s,y)`. Warm-start from parent, AdamW 5e-5 one-cycle, **8 epochs, batch 16, chunk 2000**. Low-LR variant: 3e-5, 12 epochs. Signal: **privileged outputs + step deltas**.
**Data:** train split cache from bidir teacher; plus valid-input-only streams (no labels used, teacher-only pseudo-labels) to double steps.
**Falsifier/gain:** 1x fold-1 run vs current student; kill if Δ<+0.0005. Expected +0.001–0.002 if step-timing transfers; 0 if student capacity is forecast ceiling.
**Pointer:** Vapnik LUPI (2015); Lopez-Paz et al. "Generalized Distillation"; Kaggle LANL earthquake (future-aware teacher → causal student).

## 2. Factorized level + event-step distillation (residual-of-teachers)
**Mechanism/fit:** 94% residual is per-run level offset; steps occur only at book events. Mean-MSE forces student to average level+timing and smears steps. Split: distill run-level (slow) and step-timing (fast) separately.
**Loss/targets/schedule:** Precompute per-run mean of teacher-mean `L*=runmean(teacher)` (runs from teacher step detector or label runs on train). Targets: level head `s_lvl→L*`, step head `s_step→(teacher - L*)`. Loss = `0.5*MSE(s_lvl,L*) + 0.5*MSE(s_step, teacher-L*) + 0.3*wmse(s_lvl+s_step, y)`. Served = sum. AdamW 5e-5, **6 epochs**, cosine-decay; variant 3e-5/10ep.
**Signal:** **residual-of-teachers** (teacher minus its run mean) + level.
**Data:** train split only (run segmentation needs labels/teacher steps); no aug.
**Falsifier/gain:** 1x fold-1, check class-3 corr and step-row MSE; kill if step calibration unchanged. Expected +0.0008–0.0015, concentrated class-3.
**Pointer:** Discord trick "2-stage boosting predicts error of 1st"; He et al. ResNet residual intuition; Born-Again Networks (Furlanello 2018) sequential residual.

## 3. Disagreement-weighted multi-teacher + variance head
**Mechanism/fit:** Members share 96–99.9% residual; diverse h256+h384 pairs give +0.003 but same-recipe seeds +0.001. Blind mean teaches shared bias (esp. noisy class-3). Weight teacher signal by agreement; teach uncertainty where teachers disagree.
**Loss/targets/schedule:** K=4–6 teachers (256, 384, prop0, muon variants). Per-row `m=mean, v=var`. Weight `w = 1/(1+k*v)`, k tuned so median w~0.7, class-3 rows down-weighted ~2x when disagree. Loss = `mean(w*MSE(s,m)) + 0.2*MSE(v_head, stopgrad(v)) + 0.3*wmse(s,y)`. AdamW 7e-5, **5 epochs**; variant 3e-5/8ep.
**Signal:** **multi-teacher mean + uncertainty/variance + disagreement weighting**.
**Data:** train-split multi-cache (already have 4 families); no new data.
**Falsifier/gain:** 1x fold-1 vs equal-weight student; kill if Δ<0 and class-3 worsens. Expected +0.0005–0.0012; mainly variance reduction.
**Pointer:** "Knowledge Distillation with Instance-wise Uncertainty" (Zhang et al.); Kaggle RANZCR / APTOS ensemble-variance weighting write-ups.

## 4. Hidden-state / relational distillation h384→h256
**Mechanism/fit:** h384 teachers consistently +0.0012 across 4 folds but output-distill h384→h256 scored 0.66836 < control — outputs alone don't transfer width benefit. h384 hidden dynamics richer; match representation, not just 2 outputs.
**Loss/targets/schedule:** Linear probe `W: s_h2(256)→t_h2(384)` (2nd GRU layer, last row of each 100-row block to save mem). Loss = `0.5*MSE(s,m_out) + 0.3*MSE(W*s_h, stopgrad(t_h))/dim + 0.2*relational(MSE of pairwise row-distance matrices within chunk, student vs teacher) + 0.3*wmse(s,y)` (renorm to ~1.3 total). From-scratch variant: init random, not warm-start, AdamW 1e-4→? Actually: warm-start, Muon-RNN+AdamW-head 5e-5, **6 epochs**; long variant 3e-5/10ep.
**Signal:** **hidden states + relational geometry**.
**Data:** train split; teacher hiddens cached on ~25% of chunks (every 4th chunk) to bound cache.
**Falsifier/gain:** 1x fold-1: check CKA student↔h384 before/after + WP; kill if CKA↑ but WP flat. Expected 0–+0.0015; high variance.
**Pointer:** FitNets (Romero 2014), Attention Transfer (Zagoruyko 2016), RKD (Park 2019), CRD (Tian 2019).

## 5. Unlimited augmented-path teacher-label distillation (long, low-LR)
**Mechanism/fit:** 3-epoch limit = label overfit (6ep run peaked ep3 then dropped to 0.649). Teacher labels on novel paths are free and don't overfit true labels; forces student to mimic teacher function OOD. Fixes "more epochs hurts" by removing label memorization.
**Loss/targets/schedule:** Augment each sequence causally: time-warp (random stretch/compress ±15% via causal repeat/drop, preserving event flags), median-variance rescale per instrument block, small Gaussian jitter on volumes only. Student sees aug inputs, target = teacher prediction on same aug inputs (teacher run offline to cache). Loss = `1.0*MSE(s_aug, teacher_aug) + 0.15*wmse(s_clean, y)` (clean branch 1/4 steps). AdamW **3e-5, 10–15 epochs**, batch 16, cosine decay; variant 2e-5/20ep. This is the designated more-epochs/low-LR arm.
**Signal:** **outputs on OOD paths** (function matching, not label fitting).
**Data:** train split + aug paths (5x) + valid-input-only streams with teacher-only labels (no true labels used there).
**Falsifier/gain:** 1x fold-1 at 5ep checkpoint vs 3ep baseline; kill if aug-teacher agreement < clean-teacher agreement (aug broke causality). Expected +0.001–0.002 if warp is causal-valid; else negative.
**Pointer:** Noisy Student (Xie 2020), Data Distillation (Radosavovic), sibling-challenge trick "median-variance rescale + stretch/compress 5x data"; SpecAugment time-warp.

## 6. Metric-direct rank/quantile + t0/t1-spread distillation
**Mechanism/fit:** Metric is weighted Pearson (rank/scale-sensitive), weights |clip(y,2)|; MSE over-penalizes class-3 noise magnitude and under-teaches ordering + t0/t1 difference (mode under-dispersed). Distill ordering and spread.
**Loss/targets/schedule:** Per-chunk (2000 rows): `L = 0.4*MSE(s,teacher) + 0.3*(1-wPearson(s,teacher)) [differentiable, weight |teacher|] + 0.2*quantile-pinball(s vs teacher, q={0.1..0.9}) + 0.2*MSE((s_t0-s_t1),(teacher_t0-teacher_t1)) + 0.3*wmse(s,y)`. Warm-start, AdamW 5e-5, **5 epochs**; variant 3e-5/8ep with ListNet-style top-K (rows |teacher|>1.0) rank loss.
**Signal:** **rank/quantile + correlation + t0/t1 residual spread**.
**Data:** train split cache (needs only teacher outputs); evaluate on class-3 + high-|y| slices.
**Falsifier/gain:** 1x fold-1; kill if Pearson↑ but wmse explodes (scale drift) or high-|y| slice flat. Expected +0.0005–0.0015 on WP, mostly high-weight rows.
**Pointer:** "Ranking Distillation" (Tang & Wang 2018), ListNet→Distill; Kaggle Learning-to-Rank distillation write-ups; Hinton et al. 2015 (temperature/rank motivation).

### Cheapest ordering
Run 3 → 1-ep probe (cache exists) → 6 (cache exists) → 2 → 4 (needs hidden cache) → 5 (needs aug cache). Stop any arm at 1 seed fold-1 if paired Δ < 0 vs matched 5ep-low-LR continuation control — run that control once (parent + labels only, 5ep @5e-5) so long-schedule gains aren't mistaken for distillation gains.
